body.description: Keep every shape, size, position and the camera angle exactly as drawn; only redraw the surfaces, wicker weave, wood grain and fruit in a careful hand-drawn pixel style: finished pixel art of a worn wooden market table loaded with fruit, high top-down view on a 2:1 isometric axis, the long edge running from upper left to lower right. matte weathered planks with thin seams, four slim square legs with open gaps and a low stretcher; woven wicker baskets of small red, yellow-green and orange fruit heaped low, a faded blue cloth, two empty stacked shallow baskets, a slatted crate of oranges under the table and a big stock basket of red fruit on the ground. dark brown 1 pixel outline, muted earth colours, 3 to 4 flat tone steps per material, warm light from the upper left, no white highlights, no gloss, no bevelled plank edges. Use the reference character only for line weight, colour restraint and shading; do not draw the character.

note: round 2: reference method with Kaya idle south
